technology_name: Eco-Friendly Innovation in Incense Stick Production: Sustainable Binding Matrix
problem_solved: High cost and ecological unsustainability of traditional incense production relying on Jigat bark, combined with heavy accumulation of unutilized bamboo processing waste.
description: A sustainable binding matrix formulation for incense sticks and cones that replaces traditional Jigat (Litsea glutinosa) bark with locally available Litsea deccanensis bark powder. The composition incorporates up to 70% repurposed waste bamboo sawdust and bamboo charcoal from unused inter-nodal portions. The semi-solid paste is coated onto 3 mm diameter bamboo sticks (15 cm coating line) and dried at 50°C for 3 hours, creating a clean-burning matrix that allows fragrance addition during or after production.
applications:
• Commercial production of eco-friendly FMCG incense sticks (agarbatti) and cones (dhoop)

• Upcycling pipelines for industrial bamboo processing and wood mill waste

• Sustainable raw material provisioning for cottage industries and rural artisan clusters

• Development of bio-based alternative binder systems for consumer goods
